nextStatuses.description: Statuses this member can move the request to now

canFulfil.description: Can carry out the erasure or generate the access report now

contactId.description: The person the request is about

receivedOn.description: When the request reached the company (not in the future); the due date counts from it

assignedTo.description: Member who handles it (must be allowed to manage requests)

summary.description: Summary of the request as received, recorded as the first evidence entry. Do not copy ID or bank numbers.

note.description: What was seen or confirmed (recorded as identity evidence). No document numbers.
Required when refusing or recording a withdrawal

extendedDueOn.description: New due date: after the current one, at most 60 days after it

reason.description: Why more time is needed (told to the requester)

summary.description: What was received or sent. Do not copy ID or bank numbers.

confirm.description: Type ERASE to confirm; erasure cannot be undone

timezone.description: The property time zone (IANA), for showing the time with its zone name

feedbackShared.description: The landlord may see the feedback (#5, S4)

needsOutcome.description: Live and its time has passed: record an outcome or a no-show ("viewings needing feedback")

unitConflicts.description: Other live viewings of the same unit at an overlapping time (a warning, not a refusal)

canManage.description: You may confirm, reschedule, cancel and record it

listingId.description: A live listing (available, reserved or under contract)

agentMembershipId.description: Who conducts it; defaults to you. Someone else is a manager action (office or company scope)

scheduledStart.description: Start; shown in the property time zone

scheduledEnd.description: End; after the start, at most 8 hours later

attendeeContactIds.description: Contacts attending. At least one, except for an open house; defaults to the lead's contact when a lead is given

leadId.description: The lead it comes from (moves a new lead to contacted)

dealId.description: The open deal it belongs to (moves the deal to the viewing stage if earlier)

meetingPoint.description: Where to meet. Do not type identity or bank numbers

agentMembershipId.description: A different agent for the new time (manager action)

feedback.description: Final once recorded (P6-D3). Do not type identity or bank numbers

attendance.description: Who came; attendees not listed are recorded as attended

shareFeedback.description: Share the feedback with the landlord (can be decided later)

shared.description: Whether the landlord may see the feedback

keySetId.description: A key set of the viewing's property (and unit, when the set is for one unit)

contactId.description: An attendee taking the keys; omit for the viewing's agent

dueBackAt.description: Defaults to one hour after the viewing ends
